title: Shrine of the Drowned God
description: A shrine built from layered shells and living coral stands in a grotto where the tide barely reaches. Offerings of driftwood and pearl line the altar, left by hands long gone. The air hums with something old and patient.

choices.label: Pray at the shrine
choices.description: The sea god's blessing washes over you like a warm current.

outcomes.text: A warm current of energy flows through the party as you kneel. The shrine's coral glows softly, and your wounds begin to close.
A faint warmth touches you, but the shrine's power feels distant. A modest blessing, but welcome.
The shrine rejects your prayer. A pulse of cold energy crackles through the grotto, leaving your nerves raw and tingling.

choices.label: Offer gold at the altar
choices.description: A generous offering earns a deeper blessing.

outcomes.text: The coins dissolve into the altar like rain into sand. The shrine blazes with light, and every wound in the party knits shut. The Drowned God is pleased.
The altar accepts your gold. The blessing is warm and thorough, though perhaps not as potent as the tales promised.
The gold vanishes into the shrine but the blessing never comes. The Drowned God is capricious, it seems.

choices.label: Take the pearl offering
choices.description: The pearl gleams with iridescent light. Surely no god will miss it.

outcomes.text: You pocket the pearl and nothing happens. Perhaps the Drowned God sleeps, or perhaps it simply does not care.
The pearl comes free easily, but a chill passes through you as you take it. An uncomfortable feeling of being watched lingers.
The moment your fingers close around the pearl, a bolt of energy cracks through the shrine. The Drowned God does not forgive thieves lightly.
